init.title: BL-NET options
init.description:
Choose the data source. The TA port (default 40000) adds flow rates, heat meters and all outputs; outputs can only be switched through the web interface.

Names: one line per input or output, e.g. `S1 = Collector temperature` or `A6 = Heating pump`. Prefilled with the names of the web interface. In TA-only mode, digital inputs are only created when they have a name here.

**Caution:** "Clear BL-NET memory after reading" deletes the data logged in the BL-NET (e.g. for Winsol) on every poll. This cannot be undone.

error.ta_cannot_connect: The TA port does not answer. Check the port in the BL-NET Ethernet settings.
error.ta_unsupported: The BL-NET does not log in CAN mode; other modes are not supported.
error.names_invalid: Line not understood: "{line}". Expected e.g. `S1 = Name` (S1–S16) or `A6 = Name` (A1–A13).
